title: Embeddings
description: Create an embedding based on text input.

parameters.name: input
parameters.description: The column of text to create the embeddings for.

parameters.name: output
parameters.description: The output column the embeddings will be saved as.

parameters.name: batch_size
parameters.description: The number of rows to submit per individual request.

parameters.name: threads
parameters.description: The number of requests to submit in parallel. Each request contains the number of rows set as batch_size.

parameters.name: output_type
parameters.description: Output the embeddings as a numpy array or a python list Default - python list.

parameters.name: model
parameters.description: The specific model to use to generate the embeddings.

parameters.name: retries
parameters.description: The number of times to retry if the request fails. This will apply exponential backoff to help with rate limiting.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: The endpoint to send embedding requests to. Defaults to the standard endpoint for the resolved provider. Setting a Jina URL without an explicit provider will automatically use Jina's request/response format.

parameters.name: precision
parameters.description: The precision of the embeddings. Default is float32. This should be used with output_type numpy array.

parameters.name: provider
parameters.description: Controls the request/response format for the embedding API. When omitted, inferred from url (jina.ai → jina, otherwise openai). Setting provider also sets the default url for that provider, so you only need one of provider or url for standard endpoints. Use both together only when pointing to a custom endpoint that uses a non-default provider's API format (e.g. a Jina-compatible proxy).

parameters.name: task
parameters.description: The task type for the embedding model. Only applicable for the Jina provider. Selects the appropriate task-specific adapter.

parameters.name: if
parameters.description: Condition that determines whether the wrangle runs as a whole. Recipe variables may be referenced with `${variable}`.

parameters.name: where
parameters.description: Filter rows before applying the wrangle using SQL-like criteria, such as `column1 = 123 OR column2 = 'abc'`.

parameters.name: where_params
parameters.description: Values used with `where` for parameterized criteria. Uses SQLite placeholder syntax such as `?` or `:name`.

guidance:
Create an embedding based on text input. ## Migrated examples #### Creating Embeddings ##### Recipe ```yaml wrangles: - create.embeddings: input: my_column api_key: ${my_key} output: embeddings ```

##### Output Sample | my_column | embeddings | | --- | --- | | angle grinder | [0.010793785, -0.010007165, 0.0028609, -0.0139...] | | jig saw | [-0.008975127, 0.009314879, -0.024150735, -0.0...] |
